assertions.evidence: Journey run on 2026-10-18 (see blockers for the date deviation) with guest rsv-b1-3@example.com / +15555552103. Checkpoint 1 PASS: Sites booking GQ4H0W3D, party 2, 19:00, SMS opt-in on; confirmation page shows the code and the manage link /reserve/manage#t=<104-char token> (POST /reservations -> 201). Checkpoint 2 PASS: apps/tenant-api/.dev-mail/us/20261017T111859379-....json meta.messageKind='confirmation', subject 'Your reservation at Downtown Flagship is confirmed', html contains the manage link /reserve/manage#t= (104-char token) and an add-to-calendar link (https://calendar.google.com/calendar/render?action=TEMPLATE...); one [SMS MOCK] line to +15555552103 with the manage link (CROSS-011-email-captures.txt, CROSS-011-sms.txt). Checkpoint 3 PARTIAL: the Sites-origin manage link from the confirmation renders the view (Hello B1Cross; WHEN Sunday, October 18, 2026, 7:00 PM; PARTY 2 guests; policy 'You can cancel until Sun, Oct 18, 5:00 PM.') and 'Add to calendar' hit GET http://localhost:3007/reservations/manage/ics -> 200 (text/calendar; referrer-policy no-referrer; VEVENT DTSTART 20261018T230000Z / DTEND 20261019T001500Z) - but the manage link INSIDE the email and the SMS is http://localhost:3001/reserve/manage#t=... (App origin) and 404s: curl -> 404 and the browser renders the App 'Page not found' (screenshot CROSS-011-email-manage-link-app-404.png). Root cause: apps/app/app/routes/resources+/reservations.context.ts:181 'siteOrigin = org.customDomain ? https://customDomain : appUrl' with appUrl = ENV.BASE_URL (http://localhost:3001 here); acme has customDomain null, so every guest message link points at the App origin, which has no /reserve/manage route. The consuming code is new in this milestone (apps/tenant-api/src/services/rsv-message-service.ts:333, added by 97bb99a4); the siteOrigin fallback came from 452bb463. Checkpoint 4 PASS: POST /reservations/manage/modify -> 200 (20:00) and a 'modification' email was captured; the App detail sheet (?r=rsv_226202c1-...) shows '2026-10-18 - 20:00 - 21:15 (75m) - 2 guests' and Change history 'Created / Guest / Oct 17, 7:18 AM' + 'Details changed / Guest / Oct 17, 7:22 AM' (rsv_reservation_events: type=modified, actor_kind=guest, from localMin 1140 to 1200); 19:00 is offered again by a fresh Sites search (screenshot CROSS-011-operator-history.png). Checkpoint 5 PASS: kody cancelled from the App detail sheet (POST /operator/reservations/book/reservations/<id>/status -> 200; DB status=cancelled, cancelled_by=restaurant, cancel_reason NULL), a 'cancellation_restaurant' email was captured, the manage link shows badge 'cancelled' with no action buttons (screenshot CROSS-011-manage-cancelled.png), and 20:00 was booked again by a second guest (D1HTE7B0, left in place). Files: CROSS-011-journey.txt, CROSS-011-email-captures.txt, CROSS-011-sms.txt, CROSS-011-operator-history.png, CROSS-011-manage-cancelled.png, CROSS-011-email-manage-link-app-404.png.
assertions.notes: Verdict is fail only because the contract lists 'a manage link that 404s' as a fail condition and step 3 follows the manage link from the captured email/SMS; every other checkpoint (messages and their kinds, operator history with the guest modification, the cancelled slot reopening) passed. The same broken link host is what VAL-MSG-009 (another group) must open from a captured email. Two smaller observations: (a) the App's operator cancel UI has no reason input although the status API accepts cancelReason, so 'with a reason' could not be exercised; (b) the SMS/email manage link host is environment-independent (it is BASE_URL, i.e. the App origin, in any environment where the org has no custom domain).
assertions.limitations: The second guest's booking D1HTE7B0 was left in place per 'leave or cancel that booking'.

frictions.description: The Sites manage page strips the token fragment from the URL after reading it, so a later eval/reload without re-appending the fragment shows the 'no token' state; and agent-browser eval returns string results JSON-quoted, which made the first token extraction include quote characters (the token then failed verification with a uniform 404).
frictions.resolution: Re-appended the fragment from the token captured on the confirmation page and stripped the JSON quotes before use; no token value was written into any evidence file or the report.
